summary: CDT through-hiker ('Moonshine'/Petar) triggered SPOT SOS stranded in deep snow near Pagosa Springs; spotted by Flight for Life on a ridge and airlifted out in good health after weather-delayed multi-agency effort (Alpine 2019-36 Tier 3 hoist-tech assist to Archuleta County SAR)
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team; Archuleta County SAR; Archuleta County Emergency Management; Flight for Life Durango; Colorado Army National Guard
notes: ART mission 2019-36. Exact location not stated. Merged 2026-09-15 (run 545, Colorado 4x4 line): backpackinglight thread + Alpine mission page corroborate details — trail name Moonshine, SPOT SOS ~1 PM in difficult deep-snow terrain, helis weather-grounded, FFL Durango spotted subject waving on ridge but could not land in soft snow; Guard hoist contingency; flown to town in good health.
